subject: how to convert a gff to a bed15? please

messages.author: 7f28753c909e9d5e
messages.subject: how to convert a gff to a bed15? please
parts:
I'm trying these commands

gene.obj=read.transcript.features(calbicanns_annot_bed15)

-  calbicanns_annot_bed15 must be a bed15 format (correct?)

Once I don't have a bed15 file, I'm trying to convert a gff annotation file to bed15

- here calbicanns_annot_gff is a genome reference filename  in gff format.

I'm trying the conversion with these commands:
  
gff_track <- import(calbicanns_annot_gff)
con <- file(calbicanns_annot_bed15)
export.bed15(gff_track, con)

at this moment R/rtracklayer throws an Error:
  
  Error in .local(object, con, format, ...) : 
  no slot of name "expNames" for this object of class "TrackLine"

I tried:
  export.bed15(gff_track, con, expNames = c("exp1", "exp2"), trackLine = NULL)

but the problem persists.

Does someone knows how to convert gff to bed15 file format?

thanks in advance
Flavio
